identity.title: Control Center StrategyLifecycle + Hermes Read-Only Research Vertical
identity.objective: Expose current verified StrategyLifecycle state and canonical Hermes soft strategy assessments as a read-only Control Center research vertical: a pure projection adapter over the two verified store loaders, four GET-only FastAPI routes, typed TanStack Query consumption and Strategies/Hermes workspaces with Storybook/MSW states, without inferring Alpha lineage and without strategy, Hermes-runtime, portfolio, paper, execution, live, deployment or capital authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CC-RESEARCH-01. The cockpit returns to its 14 GET-only routes and five frontend views; the research projection module, its tests and contract disappear; the two historical test guards return to their base form. No canonical StrategyLifecycle or Hermes store, dependency, workflow, credential, runtime store, execution, live, capital or persistent product state is changed or migrated.

api_matrix.reason: Four new GET-only read projection routes are added to the existing local cockpit; all fourteen existing routes and the frontend foundation contracts are preserved.

semantic_fields.reason: Source loaders, routes, ordering, identifier validation, context status, latest-assessment derivation, lineage, source independence, error closure, Alpha exclusion, frontend surface, scope, authority closure and validation flow are deterministic package semantics.

items.required_rule: lifecycle state is read only through load_strategy_lifecycle_store and Hermes history only through load_hermes_strategy_manager_store; no sqlite3, direct store open, append, init, second validator or fabricated snapshot

exactly four new GET routes /api/strategies, /api/strategies/{strategy_version_id}, /api/hermes/assessments, /api/hermes/assessments/{assessment_id}; the fourteen existing routes are preserved; other methods 405
items.validation_rule: R12 and the extended exact route-set assertion

items.required_rule: strategies sorted created_time_ns DESC then strategy_version_id ASC; assessments sorted decision_time_ns DESC then assessment_id ASC; limit applied after sorting; count is the returned item count

strategy ids match ^strategyversion:sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ and assessment ids match ^hermesstrategyassessment:sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$; malformed ids 400 INVALID_INPUT, valid absent ids 404 NOT_FOUND, raw ids never echoed in errors

any lifecycle or Hermes loader, path, schema, tamper or internal failure and any unconfigured required source returns only {error:{code:SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE}} with 503; no internal code, path, exception or raw output

CURRENT iff the StrategyVersion exists and the stored strategy_lifecycle_context_sha256 equals strategy_lifecycle_context_fingerprint(snapshot, strategy_version_id); STALE_CONTEXT iff it exists and differs; TARGET_MISSING iff absent; display only, never eligibility or authority
a strategy's latest Hermes assessment comes only from the verified manager snapshot latest_assessment_by_strategy_version mapping, never timestamp, list order or lexical id
lineage_strategy_version_ids are exact parent ids root to target within the same family from the verified snapshot with a bounded cycle and length guard; failure is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
strategy routes remain usable with latest_hermes_assessment null when Hermes is unconfigured or unavailable; Hermes routes return SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
no Alpha Factory import, mapping or inferred Alpha to StrategyVersion relationship; Alpha/Evidence integration is S10-CC-RESEARCH-02

frontend adds exactly /strategies and /hermes with query families strategies and hermes and keys [cc,strategies,list], [cc,strategies,detail,id], [cc,hermes,list], [cc,hermes,detail,id]; conservative Query defaults and active-family manual refresh preserved; no Run, Reassess, Approve, Apply, Allocate, Pause, Scale or Trade control

exactly the 15 package paths change; tests/test_architecture_boundaries.py adds only the src/operator_cockpit_research.py allowlist entry and its explanatory wording; tests/test_operator_cockpit.py extends only the exact route-set assertion by the four new GET routes

items.test: exact fifteen path FAST readiness and scope
items.expected_result: IMPLEMENTATION_READY on FAST deterministic readiness with exact 15-path diff, no certificate, and diff_scope_summary --require-exact-scope reporting no out-of-scope path
the projection reads lifecycle state only via load_strategy_lifecycle_store and Hermes history only via load_hermes_strategy_manager_store, with no sqlite3 import or direct store access
malformed, tampered, wrong-schema, wrong-path and unconfigured sources return exactly 503 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with no internal code, path or exception text
the four research routes accept GET only and POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE return 405 with no other new route
strategy detail returns family, health, lifecycle allocation, active restrictions, evidence refs, canonical strategy definition and adaptive bounds exactly from the verified snapshot
lineage_strategy_version_ids equals the exact root-to-target parent chain within one family
the latest Hermes assessment equals the manager snapshot latest_assessment_by_strategy_version entry and not timestamp or lexical order
a valid lifecycle health, allocation or restriction transition after assessment yields STALE_CONTEXT while the unchanged case is CURRENT and a different lifecycle store yields TARGET_MISSING
strategy routes return 200 with latest_hermes_assessment null when Hermes is unconfigured or tampered while Hermes routes return 503 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
the projection module has no Alpha Factory, qualification, network, paper, execution, Gate-C, append, init or Hermes invocation reference
DTOs carry no approval, eligibility, tradeability or raw output field and every non-authority flag is true
